description: This file defines a PHP class 'Activity' within the Opencart admin dashboard extension. It handles rendering the activity dashboard, saving configuration settings, and displaying recent activities. The class extends an engine controller and uses Opencart's MVC components to generate views, process form data, and interact with models for activity reports and settings.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: Controller class for managing the admin dashboard activity widget in Opencart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the activity dashboard page, setting up breadcrumbs, configuration data, and rendering the activity form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes and saves the dashboard activity configuration settings, returning a JSON response indicating success or permission error.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Retrieves recent activity data, formats it, and returns the activity info view for display in the dashboard.
